name: Land a job
blurb: Target roles, a CV and profile that pass ATS, tailored applications, outreach to hiring managers, interview prep and the offer.
description: Run a job search end to end from one request: target roles, a rewritten CV and LinkedIn profile, tailoring per posting for ATS with cover letters, outreach to hiring managers, interview preparation and offer negotiation, using the Skill Garden career and linkedin-automation super skills in order. Use when asked to help find a job, rewrite a CV or resume, apply to roles, prepare for interviews or negotiate an offer.
ask: Help me land a <role> job in <place or remote>.
inputs: Your current CV or work history

steps.title: Pick the target roles
steps.output: Three target role types, the companies to aim at and a weekly search plan.

steps.title: Rewrite the CV
steps.output: A CV with results-led bullets, using only facts from your history.

steps.title: Update the LinkedIn profile
steps.output: Headline, about section and experience rewritten for the target roles.

steps.title: Tailor each application
steps.output: A tailored CV and cover letter per posting that pass ATS keyword checks.

steps.title: Reach the hiring managers
steps.output: Messages to hiring managers and for referrals, drafted for you to send.

steps.title: Prepare for the interviews
steps.output: Stories for the likely questions, answers to the hard ones and questions to ask.

steps.title: Negotiate the offer
steps.output: Your number, the counter script and what else to ask for.
